title: Randomized NAND decision tree
statement: Define a zero-error randomized decision tree for the two-input NAND function by choosing uniformly between the two deterministic trees that query the inputs in opposite orders. Each seed selects one of these trees, and the selected tree computes NAND on every input.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution on the seed space
A deterministic decision tree assigned to each seed
Every seed-selected tree computes the NAND function
